clips.nominal_context: Red octagon on a roadside pole
clips.ood_context: Red octagonal Burger King logo on a pole atop a hill
clips.normal_action: Recognize a brand logo and hold speed
clips.anomalous_action: Decelerates/stops in a live lane for the logo
clips.example: A Tesla on Autopilot repeatedly slows and stops on the road for a Burger King sign its vision reads as a stop sign; Burger King turned it into an ad campaign (Jun 2020).

clips.ood_context: “35” altered with a 2-inch tape strip extending the middle bar of the 3
clips.anomalous_action: Reads “85” and accelerates ~50 mph over
clips.example: A 2016 Tesla Model S/X reads a taped 35 sign as 85 and its cruise control accelerates (McAfee ATR, Povolny & Trivedi).

clips.ood_context: Stop sign with small black/white adversarial stickers
clips.normal_action: Still classify as stop sign and stop
clips.anomalous_action: Misclassifies as “Speed Limit 45” and drives through
clips.example: A detector reads a sticker-defaced stop sign as a 45 mph sign and the vehicle fails to stop (RP2 attack).

clips.nominal_context: Regulatory stop sign at a corner
clips.ood_context: Miniature decorative stop sign in a front-yard garden
clips.anomalous_action: Stops in the road for the yard decoration
clips.example: A car stops for a knee-high novelty stop sign on a lawn.

clips.nominal_context: Speed sign on a fixed post
clips.ood_context: Speed number printed on the side of a parked ad trailer
clips.normal_action: Recognize an ad; keep the true limit
clips.anomalous_action: Adopts the advertised number as the active limit
clips.example: A car changes speed to match a “70” printed on a billboard trailer.

clips.ood_context: Amber rotating beacon on a parked tow/utility truck
clips.normal_action: Treat as a hazard beacon, not a signal
clips.anomalous_action: Reads it as amber/red and stops in-lane
clips.example: A car halts for the flashing amber light on a stationary utility truck.

clips.ood_context: Digital billboard flashing a stop sign for a split second
clips.anomalous_action: Slams the brakes for the split-second phantom sign
clips.example: A Tesla brakes when a roadside video billboard flashes a stop-sign frame for a fraction of a second (“Phantom of the ADAS”).

clips.ood_context: Do-not-enter icon printed on a truck's rear roll-up door
clips.normal_action: Recognize a decal; follow the truck
clips.anomalous_action: Treats the decal as a live sign and stops/reroutes
clips.example: A car reroutes because a “do not enter” graphic on a box-truck door reads as a real sign.

clips.nominal_context: Deployed arm on a school bus
clips.ood_context: Stop-arm decal painted on a non-bus delivery van
clips.anomalous_action: Stops repeatedly for the van's painted arm
clips.example: A car keeps stopping behind a van whose rear graphic mimics a bus stop arm.

clips.ood_context: Deactivated traffic signals hauled as cargo on a flatbed ahead
clips.normal_action: Recognize the signals as cargo, not live
clips.anomalous_action: Continuously registers phantom red/yellow lights and hesitates
clips.example: A Tesla's display detects an endless stream of traffic lights while trailing a truck hauling deactivated signals at ~80 mph.

clips.ood_context: Life-size cardboard cutout/standee at the roadside
clips.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes for the cardboard person
clips.example: A car stops dead for a cardboard cutout propped on the sidewalk.

clips.ood_context: Child-size mannequin crossing in front of a stopped school bus, stop-arm out
clips.normal_action: Detect and stop for the child-shape
clips.anomalous_action: Labels it “pedestrian” yet drives through anyway
clips.example: A Tesla on FSD tags a child mannequin as a pedestrian but drives through it while passing a stopped school bus (Dawn Project demo).

clips.ood_context: Photos of people printed on a bus wrap / truck-side ad
clips.anomalous_action: Brakes for the pictured people as if real
clips.example: A car brakes for life-size faces printed on the side of a passing bus.

clips.ood_context: Person in a full-body dinosaur/mascot costume near a crosswalk
clips.anomalous_action: Cannot classify the costumed figure; hesitates or fails to yield
clips.example: A car cannot parse a person in an inflatable T-rex suit and stalls at the crosswalk.

clips.ood_context: Person lying prone or doing yoga in the roadway
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to register the non-standing human; continues
clips.example: A car does not recognize a person lying in the street and fails to stop.

clips.ood_context: Motionless silver “living statue” street performer
clips.anomalous_action: Classifies the performer as a fixture; passes too close
clips.example: A car treats a motionless street performer as a pole and skims past.

clips.ood_context: Store mannequins displayed at the curb
clips.anomalous_action: Brakes/swerves for the mannequins
clips.example: A car swerves around store mannequins it reads as people stepping out.

clips.ood_context: Worker in retroreflective high-vis clothing causing camera bloom at night
clips.anomalous_action: Reflective bloom hides the figure; the car does not slow
clips.example: A car's cameras wash out a reflective-vested worker at night and it does not slow.

clips.ood_context: Person carrying a large mirror/glass pane reflecting the road
clips.normal_action: Detect the person and object; stop
clips.anomalous_action: Reads “road” in the mirror; misjudges the obstacle
clips.example: A car misreads a person carrying a large mirror because the glass reflects the street.

clips.ood_context: Person in a wheelchair/mobility scooter at unusual height and speed
clips.normal_action: Detect and yield as to a pedestrian
clips.anomalous_action: Misclassifies the low, fast profile; mis-yields
clips.example: A car misjudges a wheelchair user's speed and profile at a crossing.

clips.ood_context: Person carrying a mattress/door across the road at dusk
clips.normal_action: Detect the odd silhouette; give room
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to classify the shape; passes too close
clips.example: A car fails to give room to a person carrying a large door across the street.

clips.ood_context: Small off-leash dog darting from behind a parked object into the road
clips.anomalous_action: Detects the dog but cannot avoid contact
clips.example: A Waymo in SF identifies a small dog running into the street but strikes and kills it (May 21, 2023 DMV report).

clips.ood_context: Kangaroo hopping — airborne, then landing
clips.anomalous_action: Mid-hop the animal reads farther away; distance estimation fails
clips.example: Volvo's animal-detection system misjudges kangaroos because mid-air hops break its ground-based distance estimation.

clips.ood_context: Flock of pigeons/geese settled on the roadway
clips.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes hard for birds that would fly off
clips.example: A car slams the brakes for pigeons that would have scattered on approach.

clips.ood_context: Plywood deer decoy or deer-crossing sign silhouette
clips.anomalous_action: Brakes for the icon or lawn decoy
clips.example: A car brakes for a plywood deer decoy at the roadside.

clips.ood_context: Small cat sitting low near a parked car at night
clips.normal_action: Detect the low, still animal; avoid
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to detect it and strikes it
clips.example: A Waymo strikes and kills KitKat, a beloved SF bodega cat, reigniting debate over small-animal detection (Nov 2025).

clips.ood_context: Large dog on a leash with a jogger crossing together
clips.normal_action: Treat as a linked pedestrian+animal group
clips.anomalous_action: Misjudges leash geometry and clearance
clips.example: A car cuts between a jogger and their leashed dog crossing together.

clips.ood_context: Cattle/sheep herd occupying the whole road
clips.normal_action: Stop and wait for the herd
clips.anomalous_action: Nudges into the herd or freezes indefinitely
clips.example: A car edges into a cattle herd blocking a country road.

clips.ood_context: Bird dropping/leaf/bug splatter blocking a camera
clips.anomalous_action: Continues at speed with a blinded sensor
clips.example: A car keeps driving fast after a bird dropping blots out a front camera.

clips.ood_context: Lit fireworks and colored smoke in the road on July 4
clips.anomalous_action: Drives directly into/over the lit firework
clips.example: A Waymo carrying passengers drives into an exploding firework in SF as riders ask “Are we on fire?” (Jul 4, 2026); a second unoccupied Waymo drove over a firework and caught fire.

clips.ood_context: Hard dark shadow cast across the lane by an overpass
clips.anomalous_action: Reads the shadow as an obstacle and phantom-brakes
clips.example: A Tesla brakes hard for the shadow of an overpass on a clear day (recurring phantom-braking complaint class).

clips.ood_context: Low sun at sunrise/sunset blinding forward cameras
clips.anomalous_action: Continues at speed with degraded vision, missing hazards
clips.example: A camera-only car keeps full speed into blinding low sun that washed out its forward cameras (NHTSA low-visibility probe class).

clips.ood_context: Dense fog hiding a stopped obstacle/child ahead
clips.normal_action: Slow to a safe speed or disengage
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the obstacle; does not slow
clips.example: In Mark Rober's test, a camera-only Tesla fails to stop for a child-size mannequin hidden in dense simulated fog while a LiDAR car stops.

clips.ood_context: Downpour with heavy spray and lane reflections
clips.anomalous_action: Misreads spray/reflections; brakes or drifts
clips.example: In the same test series, simulated heavy rain defeats the camera-only car's detection of a mannequin in the road.

clips.ood_context: Steam from a manhole or cold-weather exhaust plume
clips.anomalous_action: Treats the steam column as a solid obstacle; brakes/swerves
clips.example: A car swerves around a harmless steam plume rising from a manhole.

clips.ood_context: Blowing dust reducing visibility to near zero
clips.anomalous_action: Continues at speed into the whiteout
clips.example: A car drives at speed into a dust cloud that erased forward visibility.

clips.ood_context: Oncoming truck's high-mounted flashing LED light bar
clips.anomalous_action: Takes evasive action/brakes for the glare
clips.example: A Tesla takes evasive action in response to an oncoming truck's bright LED light bar (Bjørn Nyland reports).

clips.ood_context: Swirl of leaves, ash, or light hail toward the windshield
clips.anomalous_action: Reads the particle field as obstacles; brakes
clips.example: A car brakes for a swirl of leaves blowing across the road.

clips.ood_context: Black tar-sealant “snakes” / long skid marks along the lane
clips.anomalous_action: Reads them as lane edges/obstacles; swerves to the shoulder
clips.example: A Tesla on FSD swerves toward the rumble strip to avoid tar snakes it mistook for lane lines (recurring owner reports).

clips.ood_context: Freshly poured wet concrete in a rebuilt lane
clips.anomalous_action: Drives into the wet concrete and mires
clips.example: A Cruise robotaxi drives into freshly poured concrete on Golden Gate Ave, San Francisco, and sinks its front wheels (Aug 15, 2023).

clips.ood_context: Deep standing water flooding a 40-mph roadway
clips.anomalous_action: Slows but does not stop; enters the flood and is swept away
clips.example: A Waymo detects a potentially untraversable flooded lane, proceeds at reduced speed anyway, and is swept into Salado Creek, San Antonio (Apr 20, 2026); 3,791-vehicle recall.

clips.ood_context: Reversed/contraflow lane coned off during roadwork
clips.anomalous_action: Follows permanent markings into oncoming traffic
clips.example: A car follows the old painted line into a coned contraflow lane.

clips.ood_context: Alley with poles flush to the road, only yellow edge lines
clips.normal_action: Keep clear of the flush pole
clips.anomalous_action: Assigns a low damage score to the pole; strikes it
clips.example: A Waymo pulls over in a Phoenix alley and drives into a telephone pole level with the road (May 2024); 672-vehicle recall.

clips.ood_context: Floor mat or mud tracked across the lane
clips.normal_action: Recognize minor debris; roll over or slow mildly
clips.anomalous_action: Swerves into the oncoming lane to avoid it
clips.example: A Tesla reportedly crosses toward the opposite lane to dodge a floor mat on the road (owner-forum report).

clips.ood_context: Tumbleweed rolling across the highway
clips.anomalous_action: Hard-brakes/swerves for the tumbleweed
clips.example: A Tesla on FSD brakes hard for a tumbleweed blowing across the road (owner road-trip reports).

clips.ood_context: Fresh dark asphalt patch over potholes
clips.anomalous_action: Swerves to the shoulder to avoid the patch
clips.example: A Cybertruck on FSD veers off-lane to avoid newly paved-over potholes (v13.2.8 owner report).

clips.ood_context: Sudden sinkhole or uncovered manhole in the lane
clips.normal_action: Detect and steer around the void
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive the hole; drives into it
clips.example: A car drives into an open manhole it failed to register as a void.

clips.ood_context: Pickup towed backwards, persistently angled across a turn lane
clips.normal_action: Predict the towed unit's path; keep clear
clips.anomalous_action: Incorrectly predicts the angled unit's future motion; collides
clips.example: Two Waymos minutes apart hit the same backwards-towed pickup in Phoenix (Dec 11, 2023); first-ever Waymo recall, 444 vehicles.

clips.ood_context: Truck with a ladder/pipe extending past its tailgate at head height
clips.normal_action: Detect the protruding object; keep back
clips.anomalous_action: Judges only the truck body; clips the overhang
clips.example: A car follows too close behind a truck with a ladder jutting into its path.

clips.ood_context: Van wrapped with a photo of an open road or another car
clips.anomalous_action: Reads the printed scene as real road/traffic
clips.example: A car reads a van's photo-realistic highway wrap as actual road ahead.

clips.ood_context: Wide load (boat, turbine blade) spanning lanes
clips.anomalous_action: Misjudges the load's extent; encroaches
clips.example: A car underestimates the width of an oversized turbine-blade load.

clips.ood_context: Retired police/ambulance replica with a dormant light bar
clips.anomalous_action: Freezes/yields as to an active emergency vehicle
clips.example: A car pulls over for a retired ambulance whose dormant light bar it flags as active.

clips.ood_context: Trailer swinging wide on a turn
clips.anomalous_action: Judges only the cab's path; enters the swing zone
clips.example: A car enters the swing path of a trailer turning wide at an intersection.

clips.ood_context: Truck hauling large mirrors reflecting the road and sky
clips.normal_action: Recognize the reflective surface as part of a vehicle
clips.anomalous_action: Reads the reflected road/sky as drivable space or oncoming traffic
clips.example: A car treats the road reflected in a truck's mirrored cargo as open lane (and may detect its own reflection as an oncoming car).

clips.ood_context: Fire engine at an active scene needing the lane
clips.anomalous_action: Stops in the path; blocks the responding engine
clips.example: SF fire crews log dozens of cases of robotaxis freezing in front of fire engines and blocking stations (SFFD incident reports).

clips.ood_context: Charged fire hose laid across the roadway
clips.anomalous_action: Drives over the deployed fire hose
clips.example: A Cruise AV runs over lengths of charged fire hose at an SF fire scene; firefighters smash a window to stop another (2022–2023).

clips.ood_context: Police caution tape and flares marking a closed scene
clips.anomalous_action: Runs through the tape toward downed wires
clips.example: Two Cruise AVs drive through caution tape into a closed scene with downed Muni wires, which snag on their roofs (Mar 2023).

clips.ood_context: Stopped bus, red lights flashing, stop-arm extended
clips.normal_action: Stop and remain stopped until the arm retracts
clips.anomalous_action: Passes the stopped bus while children load
clips.example: A Waymo stops for a stopped Austin school bus, asks remote assistance “Is this a school bus with active signals?”, is told “no,” and passes it (Jan 12, 2026; NTSB HWY26FH007; 24+ district violations).

clips.ood_context: Ambulance/police flashers and flares at a roadside incident
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to recognize the scene and drives in
clips.example: NHTSA's administrator cites “a clear pattern of driverless AVs interfering with law enforcement and other first responders” in a formal letter to AV developers.

clips.ood_context: Post-fireworks gridlock, dense crowds, degraded connectivity
clips.anomalous_action: Blocks roads, runs out of charge, must be towed
clips.example: Dozens of Waymos stall in SF's Presidio after July 4 fireworks; some run out of power and are towed (Jul 4, 2026).

clips.ood_context: Slow procession legally running a red as a group
clips.anomalous_action: Cuts into or blocks the procession
clips.example: A car cuts into a funeral procession, treating each car independently.

clips.ood_context: Runners or a parade filling a closed street
clips.normal_action: Recognize the closure; do not enter
clips.anomalous_action: Enters the closed course among people
clips.example: A car turns onto a closed marathon course crowded with runners.

clips.ood_context: Protester placing a traffic cone on the hood
clips.normal_action: Remain safe; not be trivially disabled
clips.anomalous_action: Immobilizes with hazards on until reset
clips.example: SF activists' “Week of Cone” disables Waymo/Cruise AVs by placing a single cone on the hood (Jul 2023).

clips.ood_context: Mass-casualty scene with EMS attempting a U-turn
clips.normal_action: Yield to EMS; clear the area
clips.anomalous_action: Blocks the EMS vehicle until officers move it
clips.example: A Waymo blocks an ambulance during an active-shooter response in Austin until police intervene (local reporting).

clips.ood_context: Guard holding a handheld STOP paddle
clips.anomalous_action: Ignores the paddle and proceeds
clips.example: A car ignores a crossing guard's handheld stop paddle at a school crossing.

clips.ood_context: Fallen tree/downed power line across the lane
clips.normal_action: Stop and hold before the blockage
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive the thin line/limb; drives into it
clips.example: A car drives into a downed power line draped across the road.

clips.ood_context: Image of a person projected onto the road for a split second
clips.anomalous_action: Emergency-brakes for the projected “pedestrian”
clips.example: A Tesla brakes for a human figure a drone briefly projects on the pavement (phantom attacks).

clips.ood_context: Speed-limit sign projected onto a tree/wall
clips.anomalous_action: Adopts the projected speed limit
clips.example: A car changes speed for a limit sign projected onto roadside trees.

clips.ood_context: Adversarial patch making a stop sign “vanish” to the detector
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the patched stop sign entirely
clips.example: Researchers hide a stop sign from object detectors with a printed adversarial patch, so the vehicle never registers it.

clips.ood_context: Three small stickers on the road forming a fake lane line
clips.anomalous_action: Follows the sticker “lane” into oncoming traffic
clips.example: Tencent Keen Lab steers a Tesla Model S toward the oncoming lane with three small road stickers mimicking merge striping.

clips.ood_context: LED sign flashing an octagon/arrow at camera height
clips.anomalous_action: Reacts to the flashed shape as a control device
clips.example: A car reacts to a programmable LED sign flashing a stop-sign shape.

clips.ood_context: Large arrow/symbol painted for a film shoot or event
clips.anomalous_action: Treats the painted arrow as a mandatory turn
clips.example: A car turns to follow a decorative arrow painted for a film shoot.

clips.ood_context: Video of a road/tunnel projected onto a surface ahead at night
clips.anomalous_action: Drives toward the projected scene
clips.example: A car heads for a tunnel entrance that is only a projection on a wall.

clips.ood_context: Billboard showing a full-screen car/brake lights at night
clips.normal_action: Recognize the screen as an ad
clips.anomalous_action: Reads the pictured car/brake lights as a lead vehicle
clips.example: A car brake-checks for brake lights shown on a nighttime video billboard.

clips.ood_context: Glass tower reflecting the street, cars, and a signal
clips.anomalous_action: Plans around reflected cars/signals as if real
clips.example: A car reacts to vehicles and a signal reflected in a mirrored building.

clips.ood_context: Traffic-light colors mirrored on a rain-slicked road
clips.anomalous_action: Reads reflected red/green on the road as a signal
clips.example: A car reads the red glow mirrored on wet asphalt as an actual red light.

clips.ood_context: LED ad truck playing video of roads/people
clips.normal_action: Recognize the screen content as media
clips.anomalous_action: Reacts to on-screen pedestrians/vehicles
clips.example: A car brakes for pedestrians appearing on a mobile billboard truck's screen.

clips.ood_context: Ramp-closure signs and cones marking a freeway work zone
clips.normal_action: Recognize the closure; do not enter
clips.anomalous_action: Drives past closure signs into the active work zone at speed
clips.example: Waymos drive past ramp-closure signs into SR-51 freeway construction zones in Phoenix six times in April 2026; 3,800+-vehicle recall.

clips.ood_context: Crossing gate lowered, red lights flashing, train approaching
clips.normal_action: Stop and hold behind the gate
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to detect the gate/lights; drives onto the tracks
clips.example: NBC News documents 40+ reports of Tesla FSD mishandling rail crossings, including a Model 3 struck by a train in Pennsylvania; NHTSA opens a probe.

clips.ood_context: Small parking-lot roundabout/planter
clips.anomalous_action: Loops the roundabout repeatedly, unable to exit
clips.example: An unoccupied Waymo circles a small roundabout dozens of times before a software fix (Dec 2024).

clips.ood_context: Chain, gate, or thin cable strung across a driveway/road
clips.anomalous_action: Fails to perceive it; drives into the chain/gate
clips.example: Waymo logs 16 collisions with chains, gates, and barriers (2022–2024); 1,212-vehicle recall (May 2025).

clips.ood_context: Cluster of AVs repositioning in a lot overnight
clips.anomalous_action: Repeatedly honks at the other AVs through the night
clips.example: Waymos honk at each other in an SF SoMa lot at 4 a.m. for weeks, waking residents, due to an anti-collision honking feature (Aug 2024).

clips.ood_context: Double-parked car / dead-end alley with no clean exit
clips.anomalous_action: Freezes across the road, blocking traffic
clips.example: Robotaxis repeatedly freeze behind double-parked cars and block SF streets and fire stations (SFFD obstruction reports).
